_comment: Live cases: real pull requests, real bugs, verified against the PR's final
state rather than trusted from the review thread.
Provenance matters here. Every expectation below was flagged by a maintainer
of the project during review, and then re-checked by reading the file at the
PR's head SHA - because a reviewer's line number goes stale the moment the
author pushes again. Three candidates were rejected for exactly that reason:
the author had already revised the code and the reported bug no longer
Rejected PRs are used deliberately. A merged PR has usually had its bug
fixed, so the defect is no longer in the diff; a PR that was closed unmerged
keeps the bug forever, which makes the case stable. The trap is that GitHub
cannot produce a diff once the contributor deletes their fork - so each PR
here was checked to still return files.

cases.name: httpx-unreachable-except
cases.description: A new `except NewConnectionRequired` clause is placed after `except BaseException`, so it can never run.

expected.description: except NewConnectionRequired is dead code - the preceding except BaseException catches it first

cases.name: httpx-typo-and-missing-return
cases.description: Stream-ID exhaustion handler misspells the attribute it resets and drops the result of its recursive retry.

expected.description: assigns self.init_stated instead of self.init_started, so the flag is never actually reset
recursive send() result is discarded, so execution falls through to an unbound stream_id

cases.name: urllib3-decoded-buffer-leak
cases.description: read(amt=None) drains the decoded buffer without the decode_content guard the sized path has, mixing decoded and raw bytes.

expected.description: amt-is-None path prepends _decoded_buffer regardless of decode_content, unlike the else branch which raises

cases.name: urllib3-clean-typo-fix
cases.description: Corrects HTTResponse -> HTTPResponse in two deprecation warnings. Touches real source, changes no behaviour. Every finding here is a false positive.
